prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_CWT_catboost leads seasonality (0.539), but ETS wins overall RMSE (16.89). Rankings are unstable (Kendall τ=0.228) with high model disagreement (spread ratio=0.944), concept drift detected, and autocorrelated residuals in many models. Robust median/trimmed_mean combining is recommended over stacking to avoid overfitting noise and handle ranking instability.
